metadata.name: MiniMax-Text-01
metadata.variant_policy: Separate Text-01 and VL-01 checkpoints; VL-01 adds a vision encoder and projector to Text-01.

backbone.context_window_notes: Card advertises up to 4 million inference tokens; report §4.2 trains to 1M and demonstrates 4M vanilla NIAH extrapolation. Config positional bound is 10240000 and is not treated as validated context.

context_extension.notes: Length extrapolation reported on vanilla NIAH; no YaRN claim. Training stages 128K/512K/1M use RoPE base 5M/10M/10M.

variants.name: lightning_attention
variants.rope: RoPE is documented for the softmax branch; no rotary operation assumed for linear attention.
variants.notes: Lightning Attention: I/O-aware linear attention with recurrent state and blockwise execution (MiniMax-01 report §§2.1–2.2).

variants.name: gqa
variants.rope: Partial RoPE, rotary_dim=64; final checkpoint base 10000000.

attention.layer_pattern: (7 Lightning Attention layers, 1 GQA softmax layer) × 10, 80 total; config.attn_type_list has GQA at zero-based indices 7,15,...,79.
attention.notes: Pinned config: rotary_dim=64 of head_dim=128; RoPE applies to half of each attention head.

moe.routing: Top-2 routing; MoE auxiliary loss coefficient 0.01 in original Text-01 pre-training (paper §4.2).

components.normalization: RMSNorm, epsilon=1e-05; postnorm=true; DeepNorm scaling in the original Text-01 report.

architecture.parallelism_notes: Original MiniMax-01 report §3: expert/tensor/data parallelism, Expert Tensor Parallel (ETP), varlen ring attention for softmax, LASP+ for linear-attention sequence parallelism. Exact M1 deployment degrees not assumed.

training.lr_schedule: Text-01 backbone: 500-step warmup to 2e-4; constant for 7.2T tokens; 1.3e-4 for next 3.2T; exponential decay over 1T to 3e-5; context extension adds 300B+32B+26B tokens (report §4.2).
training.data_total_tokens: 11.4T initial pre-training (7.2T+3.2T+1T), plus 358B context-extension tokens (300B+32B+26B), derived from report §4.2 stage budgets.
training.data_mix_notes: Text-01: academic literature, books, web content and code; byte-level BPE, multilingual upsampling and model-scored quality filtering. Exact domain percentages undisclosed (report §4.1).

alignment.sft: Rejection-sampled demonstrations from domain expert models; diversity filtering (report §5.3).
alignment.rl_method: Offline DPO followed by modified online GRPO with importance-weight clipping (report §§5.4.1–5.4.2).

stages.name: Offline RL
stages.description: Reward models select best/worst sampled responses for preference pairs.

stages.name: Online RL
stages.description: Modified GRPO with importance-weight clipping and additional stabilization.

open_questions: Unknown fields are deliberate; no optimizer, token mixture, full training precision or version deltas are inherited from neighboring checkpoints without source attribution.
